notes.title: Update for upcoming DLC, new achievement added
notes.content: Minor updates to facilitate upcoming DLC. 1 new achievement added.

notes.title: Achievements Unlocked!
notes.content:
We have just released a major update to [i]Deluge: Threnody of Crashing Waves[/i]. The main changes are:

- Achievements have been added to the game.
- A Dutch translation has been added, making the game available in 6 languages.
- About 35 minor bugs and typographical errors have been fixed.

In total this game now has 15 achievements. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2186980/Deluge_Sermon_for_the_Dead/]Deluge: Sermon for the Dead[/url] contains an additional 13 achievements.

PROTIP: if you have already completed the game, but would like to fetch the achievements, the fastest way to get them is to go to [Preferences] and activiate [Auto-Forward]. Then move the [Text-Speed] slider to the absolute right and the [Auto-Forward] slider to the absolute left. This will speed you through the game while pausing at decision points.

Thank you for playing!
Cheers, lain

leaves

notes.title: Minor patch for Spanish translation.
notes.content: Patched a bug that showed wrong image. Only occured in Spanish translation.

notes.title: Big Update — Polish Translation Released!
notes.content:
We have just published the latest update to [b]Deluge: Threnody of Crashing Waves.[/b] This update patches the last errors that were still present in the game.

More importantly, we have also added the Polish translation of the game. We are very happy to make Deluge available to Polish audiences! Translation work has been completed by Brifyjek. Many thanks for your hard work.

This update has been tested extensively. However, if you happen to find any issues, please let me know.

Cheers,

lain
Leaves

notes.title: Deluge Has Left Early Access!
notes.content:
After pulling a few all-nighters we are proud to announce that [i]Deluge: Threnody of Crashing Waves[/i] has been relieved from its early access status. All three ending routes of the game are now complete, encompassing a total of six different endings. 

For me personally, this is a game that I was unable to let go of throughout it's development cycle (sometimes to the point of obsession.) I hope you guys like it. 

We'd like to thank everyone that has played [i]Deluge[/i] during its early access run. Although we realize the going was rough at times, your feedback and criticisms have enabled and motivated us to keep improving this game. Now that version 1.0 of the game is out, your responses and comments are still very much appreciated going further.

Incomplete list of updates:
[list]
[*] Added Mei's ending route.
[*] Additional character sprite for Mei.
[*] Changes to pacing of Ina's ending route.
[*] Minor structural changes to Rika's ending route.
[*] Changes to pacing of part 1 and 2.
[*] Full script overview for spelling and style.
[*] Quality improvements on Ina, Mei and Phyrrus' character sprites.
[*] Added ending credits.
[*] Audio adjustments.
[*] Expanded soundtrack.
[/list]


Thank you for playing our game,

lan
Leaves

notes.title: Two Ending Routes Added to Deluge!
notes.content:
We are happy to announce the first major update of Deluge: Threnody of Crashing Waves. This update includes the ending routes for the characters Rika and Ina.

A woefully incomplete list of new features:

- Part 3 & Part 4 added.
- Rika ending route added.
- Ina ending route added.
- Auto-Forwarding implemented.
- Improved text legibility. [WIP]
- Structural changes to pacing of Part 1 & 2. [WIP]
- Improved background art.
- Improved sprites.
- Textual fixes.
- Changes to opening
- Added game icon

I'd like to thank everyone who has commented on the game so far. We have incorporated as much as your feedback as possible in the current build, and delegated an additional part to the backlog.

We hope you enjoy the game. The full version is still planned for Summer 2022.

Kind regards,

lan
Leaves
